title: One industrial sales workspace
sentences: G T M Engine connects industrial product intake, account research, graph matching, reviewed outreach, and pipeline tracking. This updated walkthrough follows Allco Hydraulic’s United States O E M campaign.

title: 01 / Product and buyer intake
sentences: Start with the product description and buyer criteria. Local extraction proposes fields without an external model request.
Review each suggestion before applying it. Job titles and seniority are research targets, not verified decision makers.
Technical limits stay unconfirmed. Review capabilities and approve this business’s profile before account research.

title: 02 / Source-backed account matching
sentences: Discovery checks public company sources against the approved scope and exclusions.
Inspect the account’s application hypothesis, citations, score components, and unknowns before shortlisting it.
This example uses Elliott Equipment. Relevant equipment does not establish buying intent, compatibility, or a verified buyer mailbox.

title: 03 / Native graph relationships
sentences: The native Kuzu database connects published people, companies, supplier products, and signals.

Query actual directional paths and inspect the supporting source. A published leadership role can connect to the company and a possible product application. Authority and current purchasing needs remain unverified.

title: 04 / Context-driven composition
sentences: Create a source-grounded template for the shortlisted account. Choose the channel, variant, sequence step, audience, tone, value-proposition focus, word limit, and call to action.
The saved message brief travels with the draft. Review the recipient, wording, and citations; a public company address is not a verified individual buyer.

title: Required checkpoint / Human review
sentences: The amber human-review checkpoint blocks dispatch until the exact version is acknowledged and approved.
Saving a subject edit clears that approval. The server requires a fresh review of the new version.
After reapproval, record a dry run. It creates one local receipt and credit charge. No external email or LinkedIn message is sent.

title: 05 / Synchronized pipeline and attribution
sentences: The same stored event updates the pipeline. Elliott moves to Contacted, with the dry-run mode, actor, and timestamp preserved.
Record a sales owner and next action without inventing a reply or moving the opportunity.
Board, list, and analytics share the campaign records. Reloading preserves the receipt, assignment, and balance.

title: Context preserved, decisions accountable
sentences: Billing distinguishes local demo credits from actual provider charges.
Live model, enrichment, Band, Flexprice, and email connections remain disabled. Public hosting and Snyk verification are still outstanding.
The result is a connected industrial workflow, with evidence, unknowns, and human decisions visible at every handoff.
